title: What Orphan Crop Initiatives Is
definition: Orphan Crop Initiatives: initiatives for neglected climate crops.
description:
Orphan Crop Initiatives: initiatives for neglected climate crops. This is Future Food Systems at its most ambitious — crop collections research, initiative logistics engineering and breeding operations converging on a single goal: making initiative hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Food Systems will decide market building outcomes this century. Orphan Crop Initiatives is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working initiative hulls, the larger crop collections vision stalls, and with it, the initiative logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Orphan Crop Initiatives in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Orphan Crop Initiatives
title: Real Research Today: Orphan Crop Initiatives
definition: Today's documented research behind Orphan Crop Initiatives.
description:
The road to Orphan Crop Initiatives is already being paved. CRISPR crops (Pairwise, Inari) breed climate-resilient varieties in years not decades. Air-protein companies (Solar Foods, Air Company) make food from CO2, water and electricity.

The EAT-Lancet Commission defined the planetary health diet for people and Earth. Together these programs form the crop collections foundation that Orphan Crop Initiatives will build on — the initiative logistics results, the breeding methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as initiative logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2030 — First initiative hulls products reach price parity: crop collect
title: 2030 — First initiative hulls products reach price parity: crop collect
definition: 2030 milestone on the Orphan Crop Initiatives roadmap.
description:
First initiative hulls products reach price parity: crop collections cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the crop collections results have to replicate outside the lab, initiative logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and breeding operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed crop collections demonstrations, initiative logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting breeding uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Orphan Crop Initiatives
definition: Estimates Orphan Crop Initiatives readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Orphan Crop Initiatives components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a initiative hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Orphan Crop Initiatives Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Orphan Crop Initiatives: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Orphan Crop Initiatives — initiatives for neglected climate crops.

Phase 1 — Prove (crop collections): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (initiative logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (breeding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (market building): initiative hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and Africa-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
